items.quote: First of all, let me say that Cameron is a remodel guru. We just finished having two bathrooms fully remodeled, and we could not be happier with the work that Cameron did. His attention to detail was impeccable.

Just had 2 bathrooms fully renovated and let me just say that Cameron did an amazing job. The transformation of the bathrooms is just incredible. His attention to detail in every part of the renovation shows just how much he cares about the job.

Cameron replaced various floor tiles that had been removed to reach sewage lines under my house. He was able to quickly slot me into his schedule and spent hours smoothing the concrete, removing neighboring chipped tiles.
